title: Chain Reaction Innovations opens applications for its 2027 cohort
summary_en: Argonne National Laboratory's Chain Reaction Innovations program is now accepting applications from technical founders working on early-stage energy and science technologies, offering a $115k annual stipend, non-dilutive funding, and direct access to Argonne's labs and experts. Applications close October 30, 2026.
title_cn: Chain Reaction Innovations opens applications for its 2027 cohort

title: To teach quantum to teens, teachers reach for ice cream and cell phones
summary_en: Now in its sixth year, TeachQuantum—a UChicago and UW–Madison collaboration—helps teachers make quantum concepts accessible and engaging
